Input signal data\n   * @param {number} cutoffFreq - Cutoff frequency (0-1)\n   * @returns {number[]} Filtered signal\n   */\n  lowPassFilter(signal, cutoffFreq = 0.1) {\n    if (!Array.isArray(signal) || signal.length === 0) {\n      throw new Error('Invalid signal data for low-pass filter');\n    }\n\n    const alpha = cutoffFreq;\n    const filtered = [signal[0]];\n    \n    for (let i = 1; i < signal.length; i++) {\n      filtered[i] = alpha * signal[i] + (1 - alpha) * filtered[i - 1];\n    }\n    \n    logger.debug(`Low-pass filter applied with cutoff: ${cutoffFreq}`);\n    return filtered;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * High-pass filter to remove low-frequency drift\n   * @param {number[]} signal - Input signal data\n   * @param {number} cutoffFreq - Cutoff frequency (0-1)\n   * @returns {number[]} Filtered signal\n   */\n  highPassFilter(signal, cutoffFreq = 0.01) {\n    if (!Array.isArray(signal) || signal.length === 0) {\n      throw new Error('Invalid signal data for high-pass filter');\n    }\n\n    const lowpass = this.lowPassFilter(signal, cutoffFreq);\n    const highpass = signal.map((val, idx) => val - estimate);\n      if (innovation > this.adaptiveThreshold) {\n        this.measurementVariance *= 1.1; // Increase noise assumption\n      } else {\n        this.measurementVariance *= 0.99; // Decrease noise assumption\n      }\n    }\n\n    logger.debug(`Adaptive filter processed ${signal.length} data points`);\n    return filtered;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Main processing method that applies all filters\n   * @param {number[]} signalData - startTime;\n      logger.info(`Noise filtering completed in ${processingTime}ms`);\n      \n      return filtered;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('Error in noise filtering:', error);\n      throw new Error(`Noise filtering failed: ${error.message}`);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * SignalStrengthCalculator Component\n * Calculates signal strength using RMS and statistical measures\n */\nclass SignalStrengthCalculator {\n  constructor() {\n    this.referenceLevel = 1.0;\n    this.minScore = 0;\n    this.maxScore = 100;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Normalizes signal to a common scale\n   * @param {number[]} signal - Input signal\n   * @returns {number[]} Normalized signal\n   */\n  normalizeSignal(signal) {\n    if (!Array.isArray(signal) || signal.length === 0) {\n      throw new Error('Invalid signal data for normalization');\n    }\n\n    const mean = signal.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val, 0) / signal.length;\n    const variance = signal.reduce((sum, val) => sum + Math.pow(val - mean, 2), 0) / signal.length;\n    const stdDev = Math.sqrt(variance);\n\n    if (stdDev === 0) {\n      logger.warn('Signal has zero standard deviation, returning original signal');\n      return signal;\n    }\n\n    const normalized = signal.map(val => (val - mean) / stdDev);\n    logger.debug(`Signal normalized: mean=${mean.toFixed(4)}, stdDev=${stdDev.toFixed(4)}`);\n    \n    return normalized;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Calculates RMS (Root Mean Square) of the signal\n   * @param {number[]} signal - Input signal\n   * @returns {number} RMS value\n   */\n  calculateRMS(signal) {\n    if (!Array.isArray(signal) || signal.length === 0) {\n      throw new Error('Invalid signal data for RMS calculation');\n    }\n\n    const squareSum = signal.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val * val, 0);\n    const rms = Math.sqrt(squareSum / signal.length);\n    \n    logger.debug(`RMS calculated: ${rms.toFixed(6)}`);\n    return rms;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Scores signal strength based on multiple metrics\n   * @param {number[]} signal - Normalized signal\n   * @returns {number} Strength score (0-100)\n   */\n  scoreStrength(signal) {\n    try {\n      // Calculate RMS for amplitude strength\n      const rms = this.calculateRMS(signal);\n      \n      // Calculate signal-to-noise ratio estimation\n      const mean = signal.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val, 0) / signal.length;\n      const variance = signal.reduce((sum, val) => sum + Math.pow(val - mean, 2), 0) / signal.length;\n      const snr = Math.abs(mean) / Math.sqrt(variance);\n      \n      // Calculate signal consistency (inverse of coefficient of variation)\n      const cv = Math.sqrt(variance) / Math.abs(mean || 1);\n      const consistency = 1 / (1 + cv);\n      \n      // Combine metrics with weights\n      const rmsWeight = 0.4;\n      const snrWeight = 0.4;\n      const consistencyWeight = 0.2;\n      \n      // Normalize each metric to 0-1 range\n      const normalizedRMS = Math.min(rms / this.referenceLevel, 1);\n      const normalizedSNR = Math.min(snr / 10, 1); // Assuming max SNR of 10\n      const normalizedConsistency = Math.min(consistency, 1);\n      \n      const strengthScore = (\n        normalizedRMS * rmsWeight +\n        normalizedSNR * snrWeight +\n        normalizedConsistency * consistencyWeight\n      ) * this.maxScore;\n\n      const finalScore = Math.max(this.minScore, Math.min(this.maxScore, strengthScore));\n      \n      logger.debug(`Strength scoring: RMS=${normalizedRMS.toFixed(4)}, SNR=${normalizedSNR.toFixed(4)}, Consistency=${normalizedConsistency.toFixed(4)}, Score=${finalScore.toFixed(2)}`);\n      \n      return Math.round(finalScore);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('Error in strength scoring:', error);\n      throw new Error(`Strength scoring failed: ${error.message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Main calculation method\n   * @param {number[]} signalData - startTime;\n      logger.info(`Signal strength calculated: ${strengthScore} (${processingTime}ms)`);\n      \n      return strengthScore;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('Error in signal strength calculation:', error);\n      throw new Error(`Signal strength calculation failed: ${error.message}`);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * SignalCombiner Component\n * Combines multiple signals using weighted averaging and adaptive weights\n */\nclass SignalCombiner {\n  constructor() {\n    this.signalHistory = new Map();\n    this.performanceWindow = 100; // Number of historical points to consider\n    this.defaultWeight = 1.0;\n    this.minWeight = 0.1;\n    this.maxWeight = 3.0;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Aggregates multiple signals using weighted averaging\n   * @param {Array<{data: number[], weight: number, id: string}>} signals - Array of signal objects\n   * @returns {number[]} Aggregated signal\n   */\n  aggregateSignals(signals) {\n    if (!Array.isArray(signals) || signals.length === 0) {\n      throw new Error('Invalid signals array for aggregation');\n    }\n\n    // Validate all signals have the same length\n    const signalLength = signals[0].data.length;\n    if (!signals.every(signal => signal.data.length === signalLength)) {\n      throw new Error('All signals must have the same length for aggregation');\n    }\n\n    // Calculate weighted average for each time point\n    const aggregated = new Array(signalLength).fill(0);\n    let totalWeight = 0;\n\n    signals.forEach(signal => {\n      const weight = signal.weight || this.defaultWeight;\n      totalWeight += weight;\n      \n      signal.data.forEach((value, index) => {\n        aggregated[index] += value * weight;\n      });\n    });\n\n    // Normalize by total weight\n    if (totalWeight > 0) {\n      for (let i = 0; i < aggregated.length; i++) {\n        aggregated[i] /= totalWeight;\n      }\n    }\n\n    logger.debug(`Aggregated ${signals.length} signals with total weight: ${totalWeight.toFixed(4)}`);\n    return aggregated;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Adjusts weights based on historical performance\n   * @param {Array<{id: string, performance: number}>} performanceData - Performance metrics for each signal\n   * @returns {Map<string, number>} Updated weights map\n   */\n  adjustWeights(performanceData) {\n    const weights = new Map();\n    \n    if (!Array.isArray(performanceData) || performanceData.length === 0) {\n      logger.warn('No performance data available for weight adjustment');\n      return weights;\n    }\n\n    // Calculate relative performance scores\n    const totalPerformance = performanceData.reduce((sum, data) => sum + Math.max(0, data.performance), 0);\n    \n    performanceData.forEach(data => {\n      let weight = this.defaultWeight;\n      \n      if (totalPerformance > 0) {\n        // Weight proportional to relative performance\n        const relativePerformance = Math.max(0, data.performance) / totalPerformance;\n        weight = this.defaultWeight * (1 + relativePerformance);\n        \n        // Apply bounds\n        weight = Math.max(this.minWeight, Math.min(this.maxWeight, weight));\n      }\n      \n      weights.set(data.id, weight);\n      \n      // Update history\n      if (!this.signalHistory.has(data.id)) {\n        this.signalHistory.set(data.id, []);\n      }\n      \n      const history = this.signalHistory.get(data.id);\n      history.push({ performance: data.performance, weight, timestamp: Date.now() });\n      \n      // Maintain history window\n      if (history.length > this.performanceWindow) {\n        history.shift();\n      }\n    });\n\n    logger.debug(`Adjusted weights for ${performanceData.length} signals`);\n    return weights;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Main combination method\n   * @param {Array<{data: number[], id: string, metadata?: Object}>} signals - Input signals\n   * @param {Array<{id: string, performance: number}>} performanceData - Optional performance data for weight adjustment\n   * @returns {Object} Combined signal result\n   */\n  combineSignals(signals, performanceData = []) {\n    try {\n      const startTime = Date.now();\n      \n      // Adjust weights based on performance data\n      const adjustedWeights = this.adjustWeights(performanceData);\n      \n      // Prepare signals with weights for aggregation\n      const signalsWithWeights = signals.map(signal => ({\n        data: signal.data,\n        weight: adjustedWeights.get(signal.id) || this.defaultWeight,\n        id: signal.id\n      }));\n      \n      // Aggregate signals\n      const combinedSignal = this.aggregateSignals(signalsWithWeights);\n      \n      // Calculate combination confidence based on weight distribution\n      const weights = signalsWithWeights.map(s => s.weight);\n      const weightVariance = this.calculateVariance(weights);\n      const confidence = Math.max(0, 1 - weightVariance / Math.max(...weights));\n      \n      const processingTime = Date.now() - startTime;\n      logger.info(`Combined ${signals.length} signals in ${processingTime}ms, confidence: ${confidence.toFixed(4)}`);\n      \n      return {\n        combinedSignal,\n        confidence: Math.round(confidence * 100),\n        weights: Object.fromEntries(adjustedWeights),\n        metadata: {\n          signalCount: signals.length,\n          processingTime,\n          timestamp: Date.now()\n        }\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('Error in signal combination:', error);\n      throw new Error(`Signal combination failed: ${error.message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Utility method to calculate variance\n   * @param {number[]} values - Array of values\n   * @returns {number} Variance\n   */\n  calculateVariance(values) {\n    if (values.length === 0) return 0;\n    \n    const mean = values.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val, 0) / values.length;\n    const variance = values.reduce((sum, val) => sum + Math.pow(val - mean, 2), 0) / values.length;\n    \n    return variance;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * ReliabilityScorer Component\n * Uses machine learning models for reliability assessment\n */\nclass ReliabilityScorer {\n  constructor() {\n    this.model = null;\n    this.isModelTrained = false;\n    this.featureCount = 10; // Number of features to extract\n    this.trainingData = [];\n    this.maxTrainingSize = 1000;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Extracts features from signal data for ML model\n   * @param {number[]} signalData - Input signal\n   * @param {Object} metadata - Additional metadata\n   * @returns {number[]} Feature vector\n   */\n  extractFeatures(signalData, metadata = {}) {\n    try {\n      if (!Array.isArray(signalData) || signalData.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error('Invalid signal data for feature extraction');\n      }\n\n      const features = [];\n      \n      // Statistical features\n      const mean = signalData.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val, 0) / signalData.length;\n      const variance = signalData.reduce((sum, val) => sum + Math.pow(val - mean, 2), 0) / signalData.length;\n      const stdDev = Math.sqrt(variance);\n      const skewness = this.calculateSkewness(signalData, mean, stdDev);\n      const kurtosis = this.calculateKurtosis(signalData, mean, stdDev);\n      \n      features.push(mean, variance, stdDev, skewness, kurtosis);\n      \n      // Signal characteristics\n      const minVal = Math.min(...signalData);\n      const maxVal = Math.max(...signalData);\n      const range = maxVal - minVal;\n      const rms = Math.sqrt(signalData.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val * val, 0) / signalData.length);\n      \n      features.push(range, rms);\n      \n      // Trend analysis\n      const trendStrength = this.calculateTrendStrength(signalData);\n      const volatility = this.calculateVolatility(signalData);\n      \n      features.push(trendStrength, volatility);\n      \n      // Metadata-based feature (signal source reliability if available)\n      const sourceReliability = metadata.sourceReliability || 0.5;\n      features.push(sourceReliability);\n      \n      // Pad or trim to exact feature count\n      while (features.length < this.featureCount) {\n        features.push(0);\n      }\n      \n      logger.debug(`Extracted ${features.length} features from signal`);\n      return features.slice(0, this.featureCount);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('Error in feature extraction:', error);\n      throw new Error(`Feature extraction failed: ${error.message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Calculates skewness of the signal\n   * @param {number[]} data - Signal data\n   * @param {number} mean - Signal mean\n   * @param {number} stdDev - Signal standard deviation\n   * @returns {number} Skewness value\n   */\n  calculateSkewness(data, mean, stdDev) {\n    if (stdDev === 0) return 0;\n    \n    const skewness = data.reduce((sum, val) => {\n      return sum + Math.pow((val - mean) / stdDev, 3);\n    }, 0) / data.length;\n    \n    return skewness;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Calculates kurtosis of the signal\n   * @param {number[]} data - Signal data\n   * @param {number} mean - Signal mean\n   * @param {number} stdDev - Signal standard deviation\n   * @returns {number} Kurtosis value\n   */\n  calculateKurtosis(data, mean, stdDev) {\n    if (stdDev === 0) return 0;\n    \n    const kurtosis = data.reduce((sum, val) => {\n      return sum + Math.pow((val - mean) / stdDev, 4);\n    }, 0) / data.length - 3;\n    \n    return kurtosis;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Calculates trend strength using linear regression\n   * @param {number[]} data - Signal data\n   * @returns {number} Trend strength\n   */\n  calculateTrendStrength(data) {\n    const n = data.length;\n    const x = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => i);\n    \n    const sumX = x.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val, 0);\n    const sumY = data.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val, 0);\n    const sumXY = x.reduce((sum, val, i) => sum + val * data[i], 0);\n    const sumXX = x.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val * val, 0);\n    \n    const slope = (n * sumXY - sumX * sumY) / (n * sumXX - sumX * sumX);\n    const intercept = (sumY - slope * sumX) / n;\n    \n    // Calculate R-squared\n    const yMean = sumY / n;\n    const ssTotal = data.reduce((sum, val) => sum + Math.pow(val - yMean, 2), 0);\n    const ssResidual = data.reduce((sum, val, i) => {\n      const predicted = slope * i + intercept;\n      return sum + Math.pow(val - predicted, 2);\n    }, 0);\n    \n    const rSquared = 1 - (ssResidual / ssTotal);\n    return Math.abs(rSquared); // Absolute value as trend strength\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Calculates signal volatility\n   * @param {number[]} data - Signal data\n   * @returns {number} Volatility measure\n   */\n  calculateVolatility(data) {\n    if (data.length < 2) return 0;\n    \n    const returns = [];\n    for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {\n      if (data[i -
